reading.action: Prepare before attempting floor 3. At the cistern, fuse Ember Burst + Ember Channel by channeling THROUGH the Ember-infused Burning Anger to project fire (fireball / flamethrower / wave), cast over the water to avoid collateral and to burn away the memory of nearly drowning in the shallows.

partB_fusion.note: novel fusion technique; Burning Anger's bound Ember-charge catalyzes it

reading.result: STRONG SUCCESS (margin 16) — the fusion WORKS. He channels Ember Burst's force out through the Ember-channeled, Ember-infused bar and PROJECTS fire over the water. At this first attempt + margin 16 it manifests as the RAW WIDE form — a roaring gout / wave of flame washing out over the cistern — NOT the tight precision fireball (that needs finer control / higher margin; the wave is the natural raw shape). Real, powerful, his. SKILL EMERGED: 'Ember Lash' (Novice 1) — projecting channeled flame outward through a conduit weapon (distinct from Channel=inward, Burst=explosive). BURNING ANGER's t35 latent Ember-charge RESOLVED its emergent effect here: it acted as catalyst/amplifier for the projection and was HALF-SPENT doing so (rechargeable via Essence Infusion). NO affinity tick (skill-USE of Ember, not absorption -> Ember Manipulation stays 3). NO parent-skill tick (the fusion is its own emergent thing; Channel/Burst were the ingredients). COST: Focus 104->80 (-24; bar catalyst offset some), Stamina 50->48 (-2). Cast over the water — no collateral; cathartic burn of the near-drowning memory. He is PREPARING (floor 3 not attempted — no assumed follow-up). NO Tower reset.
